valuationInputs.name: Beta
valuationInputs.reason: 8 steps, 20 Nov 2026. (1) Business: tile grout, adhesives, waterproofing and roofing (parent) and aluminium extrusions (68%-owned Swisstek Aluminium, 73% of 2025/26 revenue); both are building materials, so one sector beta. (2) Damodaran's emerging-markets file couldn't be opened from this run; stand-in as used for Alumex and Royal Ceramics: Building Materials global unlevered, cash-corrected 0.90. (3) Relevered with net debt Rs 8.83bn (30 Sep 2026, incl. leases) ÷ market value Rs 11.81bn (136.86mn shares at Rs 86.30, CSE close 20 Nov 2026) = 0.75, at the 30% statutory rate: 0.90 × (1 + 0.70 × 0.75) = 1.37. (4) Local betas found by web search: Stockanalysis 0.47, TradingView 0.86 and Simply Wall St 1.05 (2024 snapshot), none stating a 5-year window, and TradingView 0.97 (1-year, ignored); so step 4 can't be completed. (5) 1.37 is higher than any of them. (6) Within 0.3–2. (7) Into the formula by scripts/reinvestment.py. (8) Shown in the Required return tile. Refresh in January 2027. At March 2026 net debt (Rs 5.21bn) it would be about 1.18.

valuationInputs.name: Cost of equity
valuationInputs.reason: From scripts/reinvestment.py (20 Nov 2026): 8.24% + 1.37 × (4.2% + 6.08%) = 22.3%, ±1.5 points. Replaces the hand-chosen 18.5% / 17% / 15.5%. At the top of the usual 12–22% range because net debt is 0.75x market value.

valuationInputs.name: WACC
valuationInputs.reason: From scripts/reinvestment.py: debt weight 42.8% (net debt Rs 8.83bn, market cap Rs 11.81bn at Rs 86.30), cost of debt 9.64%, 26.8% effective tax. Used only for the unweighted DCF.

valuationInputs.name: Growth check
valuationInputs.value: Assumed 3% / 5% / 7%; supported 5.1% (reinvestment rate 29.4% × return on capital 17.4%). All within 2 pts.
valuationInputs.reason: scripts/reinvestment.py, FY 2026. Capacity is 95% used, so growth above this would need new plant.

valuationInputs.name: Maintenance capex basis
valuationInputs.value: Range: bear Rs 0.332bn / base Rs 0.304bn / bull Rs 0.277bn
valuationInputs.reason: No company split. Bull = depreciation (incl. right-of-use); bear = average capex booked over 2024/25–2025/26; base the middle. No named growth projects to net off.

valuationInputs.name: DCF start cash
valuationInputs.reason: Operating cash plus after-tax interest less maintenance: bear the 2024/25–2025/26 average (2024/25 had a Rs 1.36bn working-capital build), bull 2025/26 alone, base between. DCF not weighted.

valuationInputs.name: Long-run ROE
valuationInputs.reason: Five-year average about 14% (losses in 2022/23 and 2023/24), 26–32% in the last two years. Previously 13% / 18% / 23% for P/B; one set now used across P/B, P/E and residual income.

valuationInputs.name: Residual income start
valuationInputs.value: ROE 26% falling to the long-run ROE over 10 years; payout 28%

valuationInputs.name: Long-term growth
valuationInputs.reason: Lowered from 5% / 6% / 7%: supported growth is 5.1%; below the 12.24% bond yield and WACC.

valuationInputs.name: EPS to March 2027 × P/E
valuationInputs.reason: H1 Rs 3.05; second half Rs 3.00 / 4.00 / 4.70 against Rs 4.48 last year (September quarter Rs 1.44 with higher admin and finance costs). Base 4% below the Rs 7.32 run-rate. P/E changed from a chosen 6 / 8 / 10 to the justified P/E from ROE, growth and the cost of equity.

valuationInputs.name: Methods used
valuationInputs.value: P/B, P/E, residual income (DCF and dividend model run but not weighted)
valuationInputs.reason: Operating cash swings by billions with stock and supplier credit; dividend model understates a 28% payer.

changeLog.summary: Requested from Telegram (/redo PARQ.N0000 full). Research record rebuilt from the downloaded annual report 2025/26 and the June and September 2026 interims: full statements, reinvestment figures, five-year history from 2021/22, quarterly figures; management, shareholders, required return and What-if inputs added. Required return now from the beta (1.37 provisional, Building Materials stand-in relevered at net debt 0.75x market value): cost of equity 22.3% against 17% chosen before. P/E method now uses the justified P/E (3.6 / 4.3 / 5.1x) instead of 6 / 8 / 10x; long-run ROE 14 / 19 / 24% for all methods; long-term growth 4 / 5 / 6%. Whole-company DCF run but not weighted (base below zero a share at September's net debt). Net debt now includes leases: Rs 8.83bn, 1.75x equity. Business tests 1 of 4, category 3 (unchanged). 2023/24 EPS and dividend kept from the first analysis (2024/25 report not in the download). The highlights page's 2024/25 capex of Rs 433mn can't be traced to the notes (Rs 271mn booked); the notes are used.
